parameters.incompatibleCornerPolicy: disable corner correction when any RGB spread exceeds 80; do not conceal material/geometry discrepancy

parameters.boatSamplePolicy: p31-p32:16px matching deck band only, native y<800, exclude gradients>=4.5 and RGB differences>=60; p41-p42:no trustworthy common surface, disabled

visualReview.method: view_image original: both full boat-seam strips, boat four-patch crossing, overall1024preview
observations: p41-p42 corresponding native overlap has different support/rib silhouettes. Its entire seam calibration is disabled, with source colors unchanged within128px of the seam. Raw residual is intentionally not minimized.
p31-p32 only uses a16px strip of matching upper deck; samples at native y>=800 and high-gradient/material-mismatch pixels are excluded. Correction profile fades y760..880 to zero.
The boat seam protection ramps spatially between128 and384px away. No new blur, double contours or forced color target is introduced in the protected boat crossing.
The hard-cut boat join still contains directional material/grain differences; geometry/texture acceptance remains for layout review.
Blue-cloth weave differences noted in the earlier sample remain unresolved; the current task did not repaint them.

suppression.note: RGB arithmetic only; no source image masking/compositing or pixel blending.

summary.metricCaution: Includes incompatible structural overlap in two boat seams; not all pure color error. Do not optimize this scalar at expense of structure.
